desc: US PeaceKeeper MSR (Modern Sporting Rifle) cases are designed specifically to protect your AR-style or other Modern Sporting Rifle during transport. Each case offers two inches of padding overall and is double-stitched. The handles wrap entirely around the case so they will not pull out, regardless of weight. The external zippered pocket contains four individual magazine pouches, and the inside compartment is lined with brushed Tricot to wick away moisture from your MSR. It has a sling strap for easy carry and a double zipper for locking capability. This model is 35" long and weighs 2.31 lbs.
